gloss: to peel off, to tear off

definitions.gloss: to peel off, to tear off, to strip
definitions.explanation: To remove something that is attached or stuck to a surface.

examples.japanese: {壁紙|かべがみ}を{剥|は}がして{新|あたら}しいのを{貼|は}る。
examples.english: I peel off the wallpaper and put up new one.

notes:
{剥|は}がす is a transitive verb meaning to peel or tear off something attached.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {剥|は}がれる (intransitive, to come off, to peel off)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- シールを{剥|は}がす: to peel off a sticker
- {皮|かわ}を{剥|は}がす: to peel off skin/bark
- {化|ば}けの{皮|かわ}を{剥|は}がす: to unmask, expose someone's true nature

RELATED WORDS:
- {剥|む}く: to peel (fruit, vegetables)
- {取|と}る: to remove

[Register: Neutral]
